name: image-cropper
title: Image cropper
description: Frames one picked image to the shape a surface needs: pan, zoom, rotate, an aspect preset, and the output as a file.

when: Before an uploaded image is saved: a cover photo, an avatar, a logo.

instead.when: Files are kept as picked, without framing.

keyboard.does: Move the image in the frame.

builtIn: The frame announces its position and zoom.
youProvide: What is being cropped, as its name.

ImageCropper.name: src
ImageCropper.description:
The picked file (from FileTrigger, already checked for size and type), or an image URL. A URL from
another origin is loaded with CORS so the crop can be read back: its server must send
`Access-Control-Allow-Origin`, or the image does not open (rather than failing later at save).

ImageCropper.name: label
ImageCropper.description: What is being cropped ("Cover photo"); names the crop frame.

ImageCropper.name: aspectRatio
ImageCropper.description: 16:9 by default; `"free"` keeps the image's own shape. Ignored when presets are given.

ImageCropper.name: aspectPresets
ImageCropper.description: Two or more shapes to choose from (a segmented control); the first is selected.

ImageCropper.name: fit
ImageCropper.description: `cover` (default) fills the frame; `contain` fits the whole image and leaves empty area.

ImageCropper.name: background
ImageCropper.description: The empty area's colour in `contain` when the output has no alpha (JPEG). White by default.

ImageCropper.name: outputType
ImageCropper.description: `image/jpeg` by default. PNG and WebP keep transparency.

ImageCropper.name: quality
ImageCropper.description: 0–1, for JPEG and WebP. 0.9 by default.

ImageCropper.name: maxBytes
ImageCropper.description:
The largest file the surface takes, in bytes. A JPEG or WebP
over it is encoded again at a quality 0.1 lower each time, down to `minimumQuality`; when even that is over, or
a PNG is, nothing is handed to `onCrop` and the cropper says the image is over the limit (a smaller crop, by
zooming in, or another image fits).

ImageCropper.name: minimumQuality
ImageCropper.description: The lowest quality `maxBytes` may step down to (0.9 keeps a hero or slide sharp). 0.1 by default; at most `quality`.

ImageCropper.name: maxOutputSize
ImageCropper.description:
The output's long edge in px at most (a surface's size, 2560 for a full-width photo): larger crops scale down,
never up. 4096 by default, so a 48 MP phone photo stays within every browser's canvas limit.

ImageCropper.name: minOutputSize
ImageCropper.description: Under this long edge the warning shows; it never blocks.

ImageCropper.name: fileName
ImageCropper.description: The output file's name without extension; the source file's name by default.
